# Make targets named like a test, gate or control that no workflow, nightly-fast
# row, registry row, negative-control group or planner reaches (tools/wiredtargets).
# One line each: `target | reason`. Every reason starts `by-hand:`: an
# authoring, pin, census, smoke or machine check a person runs on purpose, or a
# part or alias of a gate CI runs whole. A real gate is never ledgered: wire it
# (heavy: a make row of tier nightly in test/registry/registry.jsonl).
# A line that excuses nothing (the target is reached, gone, or not test-like)
# fails the check, so this list can only shrink by wiring.
cards-conformance-all | by-hand: every card leg at once, for a person; CI runs the legs as their own rows
cards-conformance-all-goose | by-hand: the goose part of cards-conformance-all
cards-conformance-create | by-hand: authoring, writes a new card conformance case
cards-corpus-create | by-hand: authoring, writes a new card corpus
cards-fuzz-fixture | by-hand: authoring, regenerates the card fuzz fixture
conformance-big-endian-smoke | by-hand: the three-unit smoke of conformance-big-endian, which certify.yml big-endian runs whole every night
conformance-generate | by-hand: authoring, regenerates the conformance corpus
conformance-pin | by-hand: authoring, re-pins conformance expectations
conformance-port | by-hand: authoring, ports a conformance case to a leg
conformance-valuedefaults-pin | by-hand: authoring, re-pins value-default expectations
proof-write | by-hand: authoring, regenerates test/proof/proof.json
python-fixed-proof-ci-patterns | by-hand: prints the CI patterns of the python fixed proof, runs no test
python-fixed-proof-evolution | by-hand: aggregate of the evolution parts CI already runs one by one
schema-go-generated-golangci-lint-gate-ratchet-regenerate | by-hand: authoring, regenerates the golangci-lint ratchet
tables-c | by-hand: the whole C leg for a person; CI runs its parts as their own jobs and rows
tables-cpp-clean-census | by-hand: census report, not a gate
tables-cs-leg-debug-core | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-debug, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (debug) runs whole
tables-cs-leg-debug-evolution | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-debug, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (debug) runs whole
tables-cs-leg-debug-fixed | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-debug, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (debug) runs whole
tables-cs-leg-debug-wire | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-debug, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (debug) runs whole
tables-cs-leg-release-core | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-release, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (release) runs whole
tables-cs-leg-release-evolution | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-release, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (release) runs whole
tables-cs-leg-release-fixed | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-release, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (release) runs whole
tables-cs-leg-release-wire | by-hand: one section of tables-cs-leg-release, which ci-full.yml cs-tables (release) runs whole
tables-cs-region-fuzz-smoke | by-hand: smoke size of the C# region fuzz; CI runs the full fuzz
tables-cs-wire-fuzz-smoke | by-hand: smoke size of the C# wire fuzz; CI runs the full fuzz
tables-elixir-alloc-pin | by-hand: authoring, re-pins the Elixir allocation budget
tables-go-soak | by-hand: unbounded soak (-timeout 0) run on purpose
tables-goose-integrity-crc-diagnostic | by-hand: diagnostic replay of a CRC mutant, not a gate
tables-java-format-census | by-hand: census report, not a gate
wire-fuzz-release-table | by-hand: authoring, regenerates the wire-fuzz release table
wire-fuzz-release-targets | by-hand: authoring, prints the wire-fuzz release targets
moo-wire-fuzz | by-hand: the moo fuzz differential's tests by name, with a seed; test-moo (a go test of ./internal/codegen/moo) runs the same tests in CI
packet-arm-defaults-negative-controls | by-hand: a loop over $(ARM_NC_TARGETS), each of which is in a make/negative-controls.json group
wire-fuzz-release | by-hand: a dry run that prints the release gate's flags and runs no gate
